about: J-003 full MVP acceptance cases (PRODUCT_SPEC original MVP + SPEC-APPROVED changes, docs/MVP_TRACEABILITY.md). Every case is required for release; cases are never removed to make the gate pass (the gate fails when a case referenced by MVP_TRACEABILITY is missing). A case passes only with a recorded real-API result for the release target (same commit, same deployment URL, deployed version verified via kareo-version.json; see tests/e2e/results/README.md). Mock module results (C-003/C-004/C-005/C-006) and local isolated-DB checks (tests/db) never count here.

主流程一次走完：首頁 → 新 session → 有效同意 → 評估 → 需求／制度／補助結果 → 推薦 → 詳情／Google Maps → Lead → 資料庫關聯與內部查件

Session 失效流程：SESSION_INVALID 時前端清除 token、引導重新開始，不顯示或送出舊資料
